title: The Vanishing Hourglass
description: An enchanted timepiece has vanished from the Archivist's study under impossible circumstances.
introduction:
The Academy of Veiled Arts has stood for four centuries, its stones soaked in generations of magic. Tonight, something old and dangerous has gone missing.

The Archivist's Hourglass — an artifact said to slow time within a small radius — disappeared sometime between the evening bell and midnight. Three people were in or near the Archivist's study during that window. The Archivist himself was found unconscious at his desk, a faint smell of Dreamroot tea lingering in the air.

You are the Academy's Investigator. The Headmistress has given you one night.

Find the Hourglass. Find out why it was taken.

solution.explanation: Corvin Ashwick, the senior apprentice, drugged the Archivist's tea with powdered Dreamroot (clue_empty_vial). He needed the Hourglass to reverse a failed alchemical experiment that destroyed his year's thesis work. The torn page (clue_torn_page) is from a restricted text on Temporal Artifacts — Corvin checked it out two days ago and the relevant page is missing. The teacup (clue_teacup) has trace Dreamroot residue detectable by Specialis Revelio.
